en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an elevated view over the central square of Pécs, with the large domed mosque‑church (former Pasha Qasim Mosque) dominating the foreground and a four‑towered cathedral visible in the background. The square is lined with historic buildings and a few pedestrians. The caption at the bottom front reads "Pécs" and "Széchenyi‑tér". The reverse has handwritten notes in Hungarian and a small printer's mark reading "MONOSTORY GYÖRGY BUDAPEST LÓNYAI U. 18".
